name: ccms
description: Cyber Café & Gaming Lounge Management System

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.dev:electron: concurrently -n server,client,electron -c cyan,magenta,yellow "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client" "npm run electron:dev -w client"
scripts.dist: npm run build && npm run dist -w client
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client
